text:
deploy-bot: Promotion job 2024-08-18T14:33Z -> FAILED. Pushing image redwood/service-api:v2.4.1 -> registry returned 429 Rate Limit. Promotion paused. CI job: pipeline/2024/promote-789

marta: ugh, saw this. Which step hit the 429?

sam: docker push step. Logs show repeated 429s after a few layers uploaded. Suspect registry rate-limiting during parallel pushes from canary runs.

evan: any chance this is the new artifact caching change from yesterday? we added parallel publish jobs in the workflow.

marta: yes that's the only change in the last deploy window. PR #4512 added matrix publish with 4 concurrent pushes.

infra-bot: metric alert -> registry.write_errors spike @14:30 UTC, 120s window, 95th pctl requests/sec exceeded quota. See dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/registry/hammering

sam: temporary options: 1) retry with backoff and reduce concurrency, 2) fall back to single upload (cherry-pick old workflow), 3) pin to already-published image and skip promote.

marta: we can't leave partial promotion. We should avoid manual image pin unless we're sure image exists. Is there an already-published v2.4.1 in the staging registry?

evan: build job artifact shows success earlier but it failed at the publish stage. There is a v2.4.0 but not v2.4.1. pinning to 2.4.0 would be a rollback.

release-eng: Priority for this release is P1. Customers waiting. Options: quick rollback to 2.4.0, or fix publish pipeline and re-run which may take ~30-60m. What's the risk of breaking other services if we revert the parallel publish change?

sam: reverting the workflow is low risk, 1-line revert in ci/workflows/publish.yaml, CI will run normal serial publishes. Time to patch + CI run ~20-30m. If we attempt retries against rate-limited registry we might just keep hitting 429s.

marta: agree with revert for now. Do a revert commit to main and trigger a canary promote after CI passes. We should also open a follow-up to add exponential backoff and a registry client retry with jitter.

deploy-bot: Manual rollback available: toggle promotion to previous tag in Console -> "Promote from tag" dropdown. Current promotion job id: 2024-promote-789.

evan: I'm going to open the revert PR and assign sam for review. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-ci/pull/4523

sam: reviewing now. If approved I'll merge and manually queue promote job.

marta: also notify support/ops and pause the release notes mailing until we confirm canary is green.

release-eng: change window: hold major external release until 15:30 UTC. If revert completes and canary passes by then, proceed with controlled rollout. Otherwise postpone to next window tomorrow. Notifying stakeholders.

infra-bot: created incident-7802 in ops -> "registry rate limit during concurrent publishes". Link: https://incident.redwood.internal/7802

evan: merged revert at 14:46 UTC, CI started. commit: 9f3b2d1 (revert: PR #4512).

sam: CI passed for publish serial run. Manually triggering promote job now: `/deploy promote --job 2024-promote-789 --tag v2.4.1`

deploy-bot: Promote queued. Canary will run 3 nodes for 15 minutes then auto-progress if no errors.

marta: watching canary. ping me on any 5xxs. :eyes:

release-eng: if canary fails we fallback to immediate rollback to v2.4.0 and open customer comms.

evan: canary finished clean at 15:02 UTC. Rolling to 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 30m schedule.

sam: release completed at 15:37 UTC. Closing incident-7802 with root cause assigned to infra for registry quota tuning and CI team for adding retry/backoff.

marta: thanks all. follow-ups: GH issues #4524 (retry logic), #4525 (publish concurrency flag),ops ticket 7802 for quota increase. :white_check_mark:
